context.transcript:
Thanks for coming in, Vivek. As we discussed on
the phone, I'm looking for an assistant to help my
manager, Jessica, run the farm. She'll be participating
in the interview.
Hello. Nice to meet you, Jessica.
Same here. I was happy to see on your application
that you have quite a bit of experience growing
vegetables.
Yes. When I was in school, I worked on a vegetable
farm during the summer. I know that for this job, I'd
be expected to help create the planting and harvesting
schedules, though. I haven't done much of that.
No problem - Jessica will train you to do that.
I'll show you the spreadsheets that we use.
context.transcript_translation:
谢谢你来参加面试，维韦克。正如我们在电话里谈过的，我要招聘一名助理来协助我的经理杰茜卡经营农场。她也会参加这次面试。
你好，很高兴见到你，杰茜卡。
我也很高兴见到你。看到你在申请表中写着自己有相当丰富的蔬菜种植经验，我很高兴。
是的。我上学时，暑假曾在一家蔬菜农场工作。不过我知道这份工作还需要协助制订种植和收获计划，这方面我没怎么做过。
没关系，杰茜卡会培训你。
我会给你看我们使用的电子表格。
context.content_translation: 本段听力围绕“招聘与培训”展开。请先听清人物关系和对话目的，再抓取时间、地点、原因、行动等关键信息。
